suggestions.rationale: Flaky behavior usually traces to clocks, unordered collections, races, or leaked state between tests.

steps.title: Make the failure reproducible first

risks.description: Retry-based mitigation hides flakes instead of fixing them; prefer removing the nondeterminism.
